title: Can't sign in
answer: Use the password-reset flow with your registered email address. Support will never ask you to share your password or one-time verification code.

title: Billing discrepancy
answer: Please collect the invoice number and a short description of the discrepancy. Do not send full payment-card details. A billing specialist must review account-specific changes.

title: Service outage
answer: If the service is unavailable, record the approximate time and any visible error message. An urgent outage should be marked high priority and escalated to the support lead.

title: Possible account compromise
answer: If you suspect unauthorized access, use the official account recovery process and contact the security team immediately. Do not share passwords or one-time codes in chat.

title: Support response time
answer: Standard support requests are reviewed within one business day. Urgent outages and security concerns should be escalated rather than waiting in the standard queue.
